usage: 仔 (zai2) is used to refer to a son in an informal, everyday manner.
It can function as the subject or object in a sentence.
You often see 仔 used with possessive markers to show family relations, e.g., 我仔 (my son).
The word can be combined with descriptors like 大仔 (eldest son) or 細仔 (younger son).
